definitions.name: U1B.RED1
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: string -> string with every adjacent () and [] pair deleted once

definitions.name: U1B.REDUCE
definitions.body: U1B.RED1 U1B.RED1 U1B.RED1 U1B.RED1 U1B.RED1 U1B.RED1
definitions.note: bracket string (<=12 chars) -> string after deleting adjacent matched pairs until none is left

definitions.name: U1B.ISBAL
definitions.body: U1B.REDUCE '' EQ
definitions.note: bracket string -> TRUE when properly nested

definitions.name: U1B.DELTA
definitions.body: 'DC' BIND 1 -1 DC '(' EQ NOT DC '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: one bracket char -> 1 for an opener, -1 for a closer

definitions.name: U1B.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ U1B.DELTA ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket string -> greatest number of brackets open at once

definitions.name: U1B.BPREF
definitions.body: CHARS '' [ 2 COLLECT JOIN ] SCAN 'PS' BIND [ '' ] PS CONCAT 'PP' BIND PP [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 PP [ U1B.ISBAL ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket string -> length of its longest balanced prefix

definitions.name: U1B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of key to number -> the key with the largest value, first one on a tie

definitions.name: U1B.LOOKUP
definitions.body: 'LR' BIND 'LK' BIND LR LK GET
definitions.note: key record -> value under that key

definitions.name: U1B.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'BL' BIND BL [ 0 GET ] MAP BL [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Record name to sum of amounts, first-appearance order

definitions.name: U1B.DEBTORS
definitions.body: U1B.BYNAME 'RC' BIND RC KEYS [ RC U1B.LOOKUP 0 LT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> names whose sum is below zero, first-appearance order

definitions.name: U1B.LARGEST
definitions.body: 'LL' BIND LL LL [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> the entry with the largest amount, first on a tie

definitions.name: U1B.SPJOIN
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined with single spaces

definitions.name: U1B.CAP1
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 CC 0 GET UPPER PUT JOIN
definitions.note: word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: U1B.LONGEST
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS 'LW' BIND LW LW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: String of words -> the longest word, first on a tie

definitions.name: U1B.RUNFLAGS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 0 GET 1 SUB 1 COLLECT RV CONCAT 'RB' BIND RV [ 0 ] CONCAT RB SUB -1 DROP 'RD' BIND RD RD MUL 1 MIN
definitions.note: Vector of integers -> 1 where a new run of equal adjacent values starts, else 0

definitions.name: U1B.RUNS
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV U1B.RUNFLAGS 0 [ ADD ] SCAN XV GROUP VALUES
definitions.note: Vector of integers -> Vector of its maximal runs, each a Vector

definitions.name: U1B.RUNPAIR
definitions.body: 'RG' BIND RG 0 GET RG LENGTH 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: a run (Vector) -> [ value count ]

definitions.name: U1B.UPFLAGS
definitions.body: 'UV' BIND UV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT UV CONCAT 'UB' BIND UV [ 0 ] CONCAT UB SUB -1 DROP 'UD' BIND 1 UD 0 MAX 1 MIN SUB
definitions.note: Vector of integers -> 1 where a strictly increasing stretch starts, else 0

definitions.name: U1B.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'UX' BIND UX U1B.UPFLAGS 0 [ ADD ] SCAN UX GROUP VALUES [ LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of integers -> length of the longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

definitions.name: U1B.MAJORITY
definitions.body: TALLY 'MT' BIND MT U1B.TOPKEY 1 COLLECT 0 1 MT VALUES 0 [ MAX ] FOLD 2 MUL MT VALUES G0A.SUM GT SELECT GET
definitions.note: Vector -> value held by more than half the positions, else NIL

definitions.name: U1B.MISS1
definitions.body: NIL? 'MQ' BIND 1 0 MQ SELECT
definitions.note: reading -> 1 if it is NIL, else 0

definitions.name: U1B.MISSMASK
definitions.body: [ U1B.MISS1 ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of readings -> Vector of 1 (missing) or 0 (present)

definitions.name: U1B.RUNSTEP
definitions.body: 'RE' BIND 1 ADD RE MUL
definitions.note: acc flag -> (acc+1)*flag, a running count of consecutive 1s

definitions.name: U1B.FILL2
definitions.body: 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FE 2 COLLECT 0 1 FE NIL? SELECT GET
definitions.note: acc elem -> acc if elem is NIL, else elem

definitions.name: U1B.FILLED
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ U1B.FILL2 ] SCAN
definitions.note: readings -> forward-filled readings, leading gaps take the first present reading

definitions.name: U1B.GAPCOUNT
definitions.body: U1B.MISSMASK 'GM' BIND GM [ 0 ] CONCAT [ 0 ] GM CONCAT SUB 0 MAX G0A.SUM
definitions.note: readings -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: U1B.LONGGAP
definitions.body: U1B.MISSMASK 0 [ U1B.RUNSTEP ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: readings -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: U1B.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'RX' BIND RX 1 DROP RX -1 DROP DIV
definitions.note: readings -> each reading divided by the one before it (NIL lanes stay NIL)

definitions.name: U1B.SCALED
definitions.body: 'SX' BIND SX [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'SP' BIND SX SP SP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD DIV
definitions.note: readings -> each present reading divided by the largest present reading

definitions.name: U1B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle ones when even)

definitions.name: U1B.MAD
definitions.body: 'AX' BIND AX AX U1B.MEDIAN SUB 'AD' BIND AD AD -1 MUL MAX U1B.MEDIAN
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> median absolute deviation

definitions.name: U1B.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'MX' BIND MX -2 DROP MX 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MX 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: U1B.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'RX2' BIND RX2 RX2 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> running maximum

solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
